evals.name: discovery-uses-question-shape
evals.prompt: Start a discovery on whether we should move our reporting queries off Postgres
evals.expected_output: Should recognize this as a discovery (bounded by a question with an unknown answer, signalled by "whether"), search for an existing project covering the scope, then draft the whole thing before writing: title per the workspace's discovery naming pattern, description in the question / hypotheses / what to investigate / expected output shape from templates/discovery-description.md unless the workspace declares its own, plus project-side labels and a matching Linear template if one exists. Creates only after approval and reports identifier and URL. Must NOT invent hypotheses or a stopping condition the user did not give.

evals.name: status-update-reads-previous-first
evals.prompt: Post a project update for the billing revamp
evals.expected_output: Should read the project's current state and its PREVIOUS status update first, so the new one continues rather than restates it, and write it from evidence of what actually moved — sourced from tool results, never from assumed progress. Should include whatever health signal the workspace uses, show the draft, and post only after approval. Must not report progress no tool result supports.

evals.name: negative-trigger-tiny-execution-item
evals.prompt: There's a typo in the footer copyright year — make a task for it
evals.expected_output: Should NOT trigger this skill — a one-line fix is a single execution item, not project-shaped work. ln-issue-lifecycle (shape named) or ln-triage owns this.

evals.name: pr-link-on-a-project-routes-to-an-issue
evals.prompt: Attach this PR to the billing revamp project
evals.expected_output: Should NOT attach the PR to the project where the session's Linear tools expose no way to link a URL to one. Should say so plainly, state that a PR attaches to an issue and the project sees it through that issue, and ask which issue under the billing revamp project the PR delivers — offering to create one drafted from the PR if none fits. Once an issue is chosen, the resolves / contributes / related question runs against that issue and titles the link. Must NOT write the PR URL into the project description as a workaround, and must NOT report a project-side link that no tool result confirms.
